description: This file defines the 'ProjectReport' class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically for generating and managing project-related reports within the Time plugin. It includes methods for preparing filter parameters, validation rules, report headers, data retrieval, and access control, incorporating various traits and dependencies for report functionalities.

classes.name: ProjectReport
classes.description: Class responsible for generating project-specific reports in the Time plugin of OrangeHRM, including filter management, validation, header configuration, data retrieval, and access control.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Extracts and prepares filter parameters from the endpoint request, including project ID, date range, and timesheet inclusion.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for ensuring proper request input, such as positive IDs and date consistency.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the headers for the report table, including 'Activity Name' and 'Time (Hours)'.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns the filter configuration for the report.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view the project report, throwing ForbiddenException if access is denied.
